event_wedding_procession: Make way! Make way for the bride!
Flowers on every door, look at that.
Slow down, piper, the bride's in new shoes.
There they go, the pair of them.

event_wedding_procession.text: Is she a princess now, Mama?
I wed in that very chapel. Fifty years, near enough.
Keep the road clear, folks. Let them pass.

event_wedding_vows: Before God and this town, you are joined.
What is bound here, let no one loose.
Take each other's hands. There. Now you are one house.
May your hearth never go cold, and your table never bare.
event_wedding: May your hearth never go cold!
To the bride! To the groom!
Dance, you old goat, it's a wedding!
Give the piper a drink, he's earned it.

event_wedding.text: There's honey cake! I saw it!
In my day the feast went on three days.
Mind the bench, it's had more ale than you have.

event_funeral: He mended my roof for nothing, the year my man died.
She always had bread for the children.
God keep them. God keep us all.
It comes to all of us. Still.

event_funeral.text: Why is everyone so quiet, Mama?
I'll be next, I shouldn't wonder.

event_funeral_words: Dust to dust. We give them back to the earth that fed them.
They laboured among us, and now they rest.
Remember them at your table, and in your prayers.
Lord, take this soul, and give the living patience.
event_trial_open: The court is sitting. Bring the accused forward.
Silence! The court will hear the charge.
Who speaks against this man? Who speaks for him?
event_trial_witness: I saw it with my own eyes, I swear it.
I'll say what I saw, and no more.
It wasn't like that, Your Honour. Not like that at all.
I didn't see it. I only heard.
event_trial_crowd: Let him go, he's got six mouths to feed!
Hang him! No, wait, it's only a goose.
He did it. Look at his face.
It could've been any of us, hungry enough.

event_trial_crowd.text: Is he going to the pillory? Can we watch?
In my day it was a hand for a thief.
Quiet in the court, or you'll be next.

event_trial_judge: The law is the law, whatever is in your belly.
I have heard enough. I will weigh it.
Has anyone else something to say? Speak now.
Answer me plainly: did you do it?
event_trial_verdict: Hear the judgement of this court.
Let it be written: this is the court's word.
event_pillory: Two hours, and not a minute less.
Throw what you like, just not stones.
Let this teach the rest of you.
Back from the boards, the lot of you.
crowd_spectacle_pillory: Poor devil. It was only bread.

crowd_spectacle_pillory.text: Children, that's what stealing gets you.
Move along, it's not a fair.

event_execution: He killed a man. This is what comes of it.
event_execution_priest: Confess, my son, and go to God clean.
There is mercy yet, for the one who asks it.
Lord, forgive this man, as we must.
crowd_spectacle_execution: Dawn, and a drum. I hate the sound of it.
They say he never said a word.
Pray for him. Pray for his mother.
event_fair_crier: Come see the fire-eater from the southern sands!
Cloth from the coast! Knives from the north! Come and look!
The archery's at noon! Ten arrows, a purse for the best eye!
Sweet cakes, sweet wine, a juggler and a bear! Well, no bear.
Pedlars from three counties! See it all before the bell!
event_fair_stage: Watch now, watch the flame go down!
Three apples, four, five! Who'll throw me a sixth?
A coin for the players, good people, a coin!
Ladies and gentlefolk, the great swallowing of fire!
event_fair: I've spent a week's wages and it's not noon.
Did you see the cloth? Blue as a jay.
Mind your purse in a crowd like this.

event_fair.text: Can I have a honey cake? Please?
Fair prices, fair weights! Come buy!
Watch for cutpurses. They love a fair.

crowd_spectacle_archery: Hold your breath, then loose. That's the trick.

crowd_spectacle_archery.text: When I'm big I'll shoot the far one.

crowd_spectacle_fair: Look at him, he's eating the fire!
How does he not burn his tongue?
event_tournament_herald: Knights, to your lists! Lances up!
For the honour of the house, and the favour of the lord!
A lance broken! A clean strike!
Hear me, good people: the lists are open!
event_tournament_melee: The melee for all comers! Who will face the champion?
Into the ring, if you have the stomach for it!
To yield is no shame, to die is no glory. Fight well!
A purse and a horse to whoever bests him!
event_tournament: Did you see that lance shatter?
My cousin's in the lists. Second from the left.
The lord's box is full of silk today.

event_tournament.text: I want to be a knight!
Keep behind the rail, you'll get trampled.

crowd_spectacle_joust: That one's going to feel it tomorrow.
crowd_spectacle_melee: The champion's never been beaten. Not once.
event_fire: The thatch has caught! It's going up!
Is everyone out? Is everyone out?

event_fire.text: Children, stay back. Stay here with me.
Form a line! Buckets, hand to hand!

event_fire_after: There's nothing left of the roof.
They'll stay with her sister till it's done.
A spark from the chimney, they say.
crowd_spectacle_fire: It'll take the next house too!
Look at the smoke. Black as pitch.
event_tax: Ten in a hundred, and the roof still leaks.
There goes the lord's share. And ours with it.
He takes our coin and gives us a fine speech.
Not the pig. They wouldn't take the pig.

event_tax.text: Why does the man take our money, Mama?
Mind your tongues. He has ears, that one.
Keep it civil. The lord's men are here.

crowd_spectacle_tax: Count it twice, reeve, he'll cheat you.
Poor souls. That pig was all they had.
event_raid: To arms! Raiders in the street!
Bar the doors! Bar the doors!
After them, they've got the sacks!

event_raid.text: Not one sack leaves this town!

event_topping_out: A bough on the ridge, she'll stand a hundred years!
Drink to the roof! Drink to the beams!
Not a nail bent. Well, hardly.
To the master, and the crew!
event_christening: Welcome to the world, little one.
What a pair of lungs on that child!
May you grow strong and kind.
event_cart: Don't just stand there, help me!
event_cart_help: Get the hay off the road before the next cart comes.
event_pig_owner: My pig! Somebody stop my pig!
Catch it! There's a penny in it!
That's the third time this month.
event_troupe: A tale of a king and a fool, good people!
And the fool says to the king...
crowd_spectacle_troupe: That's the miller to the life!
Again, the bit with the goat!
event_preacher: Repent! The hour is later than you think!
Charity is the hand of God on earth!
The rich man feasts, the poor man prays. Which will be saved?
Look to your souls, good people, look to your souls!
event_preacher_crowd: Every week the same fire and brimstone.
event_horse_fair: Sound in wind and limb! Look at those legs!
Ride her round the square, see for yourself.
A mare like that won't stand here long.
Fair price for a fair beast.
event_slaughter: Hold it still. Still, I said.
A good fat one. We'll eat well this winter.
Children, go and fetch the salt.
event_decree: Hear ye, hear ye! By order of the lord!
Let it be known in {settlement} and all the land about!
The lord decrees, and so it shall be.
Hear ye! No fires in the open after curfew!
event_decree_crowd: What did he say? I didn't catch it.
As long as it's not another tax.
crowd_spectacle_decree: Who's it from? The lord himself?
event_well_quarrel: You've been in my turn at the well three days running!
Say that again, I dare you.
My mother warned me about your family.
You owe me a bucket. A whole bucket!
event_well_crowd: Somebody fetch the reeve before it's fists.
event_lost_child: Has anyone seen my boy? He went for water and never came back!
Please, help us look. It'll be dark soon.
event_lost_child_search: Bring a torch, check the barns.
Over by the mill! I heard something!
Call his name, he knows our voices.
event_lost_child_found: We found him! Asleep in the hay, the little wretch!
event_oath: Your word, given here, binds you to this house.
Rise, and keep faith with us.
event_oath_crowd: May they keep it longer than the last one.
event_dubbing: Kneel. By this blade I name you a knight of this house.
Rise, and be worthy of it.
Protect the weak, honour your lord, fear nothing.
crowd_spectacle_dubbing: I knew it'd come to that one day.
crowd_spectacle_wedding: He's sweating like a horse, look at him.
crowd_spectacle_trial: The judge looks sour today. Bad luck for him.
